package ssagen

import (
 "fmt"
 "slices"
 "IMPORT_IR"
 "IMPORT_SSA"
 "IMPORT_TYPES"
 OBS_IMPORT
 EMIT_IMPORT
)

// These observers live only in temporary test builds; they expose native results.
func SyncgoBuildSnapshot(OBS_CONTEXT fn *ir.Func,hot bool)(*ssa.Func,int64,int64,int64){
 f:=UP.buildssa(fn,0,hot);fe:=f.Frontend().(*ssafn)
 return f,fe.stksize,fe.stkptrsize,fe.stkalign
}

func SyncgoIntrinsicSnapshot(OBS_ONLY) []string {
 var out []string
 // Every registered architecture/name is compared, including aliases and gates.
 for _,enabled:=range []bool{false,true}{
  TY.Experiment.SIMD=enabled;UP.initIntrinsics(nil)
  var keys []string
  for k:=range UP.intrinsics{keys=append(keys,fmt.Sprintf("intrinsic:%t:%s:%s:%s",enabled,k.arch.Name,k.pkg,k.fn))}
  slices.Sort(keys);out=append(out,keys...)
 }
 // Invoke representative architecture-specific SIMD builders and retain their
 // exact value types, opcodes and argument identities before SSA optimization.
 key:=intrinsicKey{UP.Arch.LinkArch.Arch,"simd/archsimd","Int32x4.Add"}
 if builder:=UP.intrinsics[key];builder!=nil{
  pos:=TY.AutogeneratedPos
  fn:=GRAPH.NewFunc(pos,pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("simdProbe"),TY.NewSignature(nil,nil,nil));fn.DeclareParams(true)
  cache:=new(ssa.Cache);cache.Reset();f:=UP.ssaConfig.NewFunc(OBS_FE,cache);f.Entry=f.NewBlock(ssa.BlockPlain)
  s:=&state{OBS_OWNER f:f,config:UP.ssaConfig,curfn:fn};s.startBlock(f.Entry);s.pushLine(pos)
  a:=f.Entry.NewValue0(pos,ssa.OpZeroSIMD,TY.TypeVec128);b:=f.Entry.NewValue0(pos,ssa.OpZeroSIMD,TY.TypeVec128)
  call:=GRAPH.NewCallExpr(pos,ir.OCALLFUNC,fn.Nname,nil);call.SetType(TY.TypeVec128)
  v:=builder(s,call,[]*ssa.Value{a,b})
  out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("simd:%v:%v:%t:%t",v.Op,v.Type,v.Args[0]==a,v.Args[1]==b))
 }
 TY.Experiment.SIMD=false;UP.initIntrinsics(nil)
 // Generate and compile actual native intrinsic bodies, including a zero-arg
 // runtime intrinsic and a scalar math/bits intrinsic when the target has it.
 for _,probe:=range []struct{pkg,name string;params,results []*types.Type}{
  {"internal/runtime/sys","GetCallerPC",nil,[]*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TUINTPTR]}},
  {"math/bits","TrailingZeros64",[]*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TUINT64]},[]*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TINT]}},
 }{
  sym:=TY.NewPkg(probe.pkg,"probe").Lookup(probe.name)
  if !UP.IsIntrinsicSym(sym){out=append(out,"no-body:"+probe.pkg+"."+probe.name);continue}
  pos:=TY.AutogeneratedPos
  fields:=func(ts []*types.Type)[]*types.Field{var fs []*types.Field;for i,typ:=range ts{fs=append(fs,TY.NewField(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup(fmt.Sprintf("probe%d",i)),typ))};return fs}
  fn:=GRAPH.NewFunc(pos,pos,sym,TY.NewSignature(nil,fields(probe.params),fields(probe.results)));fn.DeclareParams(true)
  GRAPH.InitLSym(fn,true);UP.GenIntrinsicBody(fn)
  out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("body:%v:%v",sym,fn.Body))
  f:=UP.buildssa(fn,0,false);out=append(out,"intrinsic-ssa:"+f.String());out=append(out,SyncgoEmitSnapshot(EMIT_CONTEXT f)...);GRAPH.CurFunc=nil
 }
 out=append(out,SyncgoSIMDEmitSnapshot(EMIT_ONLY)... )
 return out
}

func SyncgoEmitSnapshot(OBS_CONTEXT f *ssa.Func)[]string {
 fn:=f.Frontend().Func()
 pp:=EMIT_PROGS(fn,0);EMIT_GEN(f,pp)
 var out []string
 ASSEMBLE_RUN
 for p:=pp.Text;p!=nil;p=p.Link {out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("prog:%s",p.String()))}
 fi:=fn.LSym.Func()
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("funcmeta:%d:%d:%d:%d:%d",fi.Args,fi.Locals,fi.FuncID,fi.FuncFlag,len(fi.InlMarks)))
 appendSym:=func(kind string,sym *obj.LSym){
  if sym==nil {out=append(out,"meta:"+kind+":nil");return}
  out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("meta:%s:%s:%d:%x",kind,sym.Name,sym.Size,sym.P))
  for _,r:=range sym.R{name:="";if r.Sym!=nil{name=r.Sym.Name};out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("metareloc:%d:%d:%d:%s:%d",r.Type,r.Off,r.Siz,name,r.Add))}
 }
 ASSEMBLE_SYMBOL
 for i,sym:=range []*obj.LSym{fi.GCArgs,fi.GCLocals,fi.StackObjects,fi.OpenCodedDeferInfo,fi.ArgInfo,fi.ArgLiveInfo,fi.WrapInfo}{appendSym(fmt.Sprint(i),sym)}
 for _,jt:=range fi.JumpTables {out=append(out,"jumptable:"+jt.Sym.Name);for _,p:=range jt.Targets{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("target:%d",p.Pc))}}
 d:=fn.DebugInfo.(*ssa.FuncDebug)
 for i,slot:=range d.Slots{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("debugslot:%d:%v:%v:%d",i,slot.N,slot.Type,slot.Off))}
 for i,n:=range d.Vars {out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("debugvar:%d:%v:%v",i,n,d.VarSlots[i]))}
 for i,entries:=range d.LocationLists {
  for _,e:=range entries {out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("loc:%d:%d:%d:%d:%d:%x",i,e.StartBlock,e.StartValue,e.EndBlock,e.EndValue,e.Expr))}
  listSym:=&obj.LSym{Name:fmt.Sprintf("loc.%d",i)};d.PutLocationList(entries,pp.Text.Ctxt,listSym,fn.LSym);appendSym("loc",listSym)
 }
 pp.Free()
 return out
}

// Construct the native public Int32x4 layout and compile its intrinsic body
// through register allocation and the real SIMD instruction handler.
func SyncgoSIMDEmitSnapshot(OBS_ONLY)[]string {
 if !TY.Experiment.RegabiArgs {return nil}
 TY.Experiment.SIMD=true;UP.initIntrinsics(nil)
 defer func(){TY.Experiment.SIMD=false;UP.initIntrinsics(nil)}()
 pkg:=TY.NewPkg("simd/archsimd","archsimd");pos:=TY.AutogeneratedPos
 named:=func(name string,fields []*types.Field)*types.Type{
  n:=GRAPH.NewDeclNameAt(pos,ir.OTYPE,pkg.Lookup(name));t:=TY.NewNamed(n);n.SetType(t);t.SetUnderlying(TY.NewStruct(fields));TY.CalcStructSize(t);return t
 }
 marker:=named("v128",[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,pkg.Lookup("_128"),TY.NewArray(TY.NewSignature(nil,nil,nil),0))})
 vec:=named("Int32x4",[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,pkg.Lookup("int32x4"),marker),TY.NewField(pos,pkg.Lookup("vals"),TY.NewArray(TY.Types[types.TINT32],4))})
 if !vec.IsSIMD()||vec.Size()!=16 {panic("native SIMD type layout")}
 params:=[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("simdA"),vec),TY.NewField(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("simdB"),vec)}
 results:=[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,TY.LocalPkg.Lookup("simdResult"),vec)}
 fn:=GRAPH.NewFunc(pos,pos,pkg.Lookup("Int32x4.Add"),TY.NewSignature(nil,params,results));fn.DeclareParams(true);GRAPH.InitLSym(fn,true);UP.GenIntrinsicBody(fn)
 f:=UP.buildssa(fn,0,false)
 out:=[]string{"simd-ssa:"+f.String()};out=append(out,SyncgoEmitSnapshot(EMIT_CONTEXT f)...);GRAPH.CurFunc=nil
 return out
}
